Node Editor — Visual Data Pipeline Builder

Build visual data pipelines to join, filter, transform, and enrich tables without writing code. VLOOKUP, Join, Filter, Formula, and API nodes connect via drag-and-drop wires. Runs in the browser.

What you can do

  • VLOOKUP — enrich a table by matching columns from a reference table
  • Join — merge two tables with Inner, Left, Right, or Full Outer joins
  • Filter — keep rows matching conditions (equals, contains, regex, numeric range)
  • Formula — add computed columns using arithmetic, logic, and string functions
  • API node — fetch live JSON data from external URLs into the pipeline
  • Topological execution engine handles complex multi-node pipelines automatically
  • Graph structure persists between sessions
